    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdminPanel
    Admin / Librarian panel: a sidebar (Dashboard, Books, Issue/Return, Members, Overdue, Transactions, Logout) and a CardLayout content area showing the selected page.
    AuthService
    Authentication service: sign up, sign in, role detection and password hashing.
    Book
    Represents a book in the library system.
    BooksPanel
    Admin book management: add, view, update, delete and change status of books, with a live search and filter bar above the table.
    BookStatus
    Enum representing the status of a book in the library.
    BrowseBooksPanel
    Student "Browse Books" page: read-only catalogue with the same search and filter bar as the admin view.
    Category
    Enum representing the category of a book in the library.
    DashboardPanel
    Admin dashboard: coloured statistic cards (Total, Available, Issued and Reserved books, Total Members, Overdue count) and a table of the most recent activity.
    DataStore
    File-based persistence for the library.
    GlassBackground
    Window background for the liquid glass theme: a near-black base lit by soft, large blue and cyan glows, with a darker vignette at the bottom.
    IssueReturnPanel
    Issue and return screen.
    LibraryException
    Custom checked exception used for all validation and business logic errors in the Library Management System.
    LibraryService
    Service class providing all book-related business logic and library operations.
    LibrarySystem
    Wires all services together and connects them to the DataStore.
    Loan
    Represents a loan record for a book issued to a member.
    LoginFrame
    The start window: a split layout with a branding panel on the left and a form card on the right that switches between Sign In and SignUpPanel.
    LoginFrame.BrandingPanel
    Left-hand branding area: floating liquid-glass orbs, a large title with a blue-to-cyan gradient, a tagline and the feature list.
    LoginFrame.GradientLabel
    Label whose text is painted with a blue-to-cyan gradient.
    Main
    Entry point of the Library Book Management System.
    MainFrame
    Main application window shown after login.
    Member
    Represents a library member.
    MemberService
    Service class for library member management: registration with auto-generated member IDs (MEM-001, MEM-002, ...), update, delete, lookup and search.
    MembersPanel
    Member management: register members (auto-generated MEM-xxx IDs), view them in a table, search by name or ID, update and delete (members with active loans cannot be deleted).
    MyBooksPanel
    Student "My Books" page: the student's currently issued and reserved books with issue date, due date and an overdue warning (rows highlighted in red) when a book is late.
    MyHistoryPanel
    Student "My History" page: the student's own transactions (issues, returns, reservations and cancellations), newest first.
    NavigationPanel
    Base class for role panels: a SidebarPanel on the left and a CardLayout content area on the right.
    OverduePanel
    Overdue tracking: lists every loan that has not been returned and whose due date is before today, with the number of days overdue.
    Refreshable
    Implemented by panels that can reload their data from the services after a change.
    Role
    Enum representing the role of a user in the system.
    SearchFilterBar
    Reusable search and filter bar for book tables: a search text field, a search-by combo (Book ID / Title / Author), a status filter, a category filter and a Reset button.
    SidebarPanel
    Frosted dark glass sidebar navigation used by the Admin and Student panels.
    SidebarPanel.NavButton
    A sidebar navigation button.
    SignUpPanel
    Sign-up form: Full Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password and, only when the email matches the admin pattern, an Admin Access Code field.
    StatCard
    Reusable dashboard statistic card: a frosted glass card with an accent glow, a liquid-glass icon orb, a large number and a label.
    StudentPanel
    Student panel (read-only access to the catalogue): sidebar with Browse Books, My Books, My History and Logout, plus a top bar showing "Welcome, name" and a summary of the student's issued, reserved and overdue books.
    TableCard
    A container that shows either a styled table or a friendly empty-state message (for example "The library is empty.
    Transaction
    Represents a transaction record in the library system.
    TransactionService
    Service that keeps the persistent transaction log (ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, STATUS_CHANGE, ISSUE, RETURN, RESERVE, CANCEL_RESERVATION) and provides filtered, newest-first views of it.
    TransactionsPanel
    Transaction history: the persistent log of all operations (newest first) with a filter by transaction type.
    TransactionType
    Enum representing the type of a transaction in the library system.
    UIStyle
    Central place for the application's "liquid glass" look: a black and deep-blue palette, fonts, the Swing theme set-up, and factory methods for glass buttons, inputs, combo boxes, frosted cards, dark tables and dialogs.
    UIStyle.ArrowButton
    Small chevron button used by combo boxes and spinners.
    UIStyle.EmojiIcon
    Icon that draws a short emoji/symbol string with an emoji-capable font, so symbols render correctly next to text that uses Segoe UI (which has no emoji glyphs).
    UIStyle.FlatButton
    A liquid-glass pill button: translucent gradient body, glossy top highlight, light rim and a soft glow on hover.
    UIStyle.GlassComboBoxUI
    Combo box UI with a dark rounded body, blue chevron and dark popup list.
    UIStyle.GlassListRenderer<T>
    Dark list renderer for combo box popups.
    UIStyle.GlassPasswordField
    A dark rounded glass password field.
    UIStyle.GlassScrollBarUI
    Thin translucent scroll bar with a rounded blue glass thumb and no arrow buttons.
    UIStyle.GlassSpinnerUI
    Spinner UI with chevron buttons and a dark rounded body.
    UIStyle.GlassTextField
    A dark rounded glass text field.
    UIStyle.HeaderRenderer
    Bold table header renderer: dark blue background, light blue text and a glowing accent line at the bottom.
    UIStyle.LiquidDotIcon
    A small glossy liquid-glass dot, used as a bullet.
    UIStyle.RoundedFieldBorder
    Rounded outline border for inputs; glows blue while the component has focus.
    UIStyle.RoundedPanel
    A frosted liquid-glass card with rounded corners, a gradient rim and a top sheen.
    UIStyle.StripedRenderer
    Cell renderer with alternating dark rows, padding and optional red highlighting.
    User
    Represents a registered user in the library system.
